scope: Opening/licensing and relevant optional development funding; operating resources explicitly separated

process.name: Check need, governance and route
process.currentProcedure: Use recommended survey; build partnerships; complete centre development information session. Decide operator structure. Eligible government-funded development is nonprofit/co-operative/municipal. Private operators can seek a licence without entitlement to grants.

process.name: Submit development request
process.currentProcedure: Email current CNA and supporting budgets/incorporation documents. Business plan and community support letters may strengthen application. Ministry acknowledges receipt and checks completeness. Year-round intake; new spaces/funding targeted to greatest need, no guaranteed approval or published fixed timeline.

process.name: After Ministry notification
process.currentProcedure: Work with ELCC consultant on licence application, relevant grant applications and capital agreement. Set up payments if receiving funding. Developmental licence, allocation/funding and final operating licence are distinct decisions.

process.name: Prepare premises, staff and policies
process.currentProcedure: Initial consultant meeting discusses standards and measures space. Arrange independent fire/heating/health inspections; develop required handbook and governance documents, insurance, floor plan, menu and fee schedule. Correct deficiencies.

process.name: Final Ministry review before opening
process.currentProcedure: Checklist asks final meeting at least four weeks before anticipated opening, to measure final space and discuss compliance. This is a meeting lead time, not a guaranteed total processing period. Ministry decides operating licence; funding decisions remain separate.

limitations: This is a researched inventory of live public opening-centre catalogue items, linked templates and explicitly referenced missing forms as of 2026-11-25, not a claim to possess every consultant or internal system form.
Field requiredness unknown means the source prints a field but does not state whether every applicant must fill it. Form-level requiredness and conditions are separate.
Current public files can retain old legal references and rates. Saved source PDF/workbook is authoritative evidence of the form itself, not proof every printed policy is current.
The catalogue product publication date is often older than the actual replacement file. Prefer live download and printed revision; PDF metadata is recorded as metadata, not a policy effective date.
Online Enrolment Portal screens were not authenticated or inspected. Public checklist says fee schedules are submitted online; process must not be described as entirely paper-based.
Optional grants, operating claims and supporting drafting templates must not block an initial licensing application solely because they appear in this inventory.
